turns.replyText:
I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I completely get that. When you’ve been let down before, it makes sense to be extra careful about what you choose.

A few things about our plants that might help:

All our roses are grown on their own roots in 1-gallon containers (we do not sell bare-root roses), and they are true to variety and virus-free.
Plants are defoliated before shipping so they travel well, then leaf out again once planted.
We grow and ship directly from our nurseries in Oregon so you are getting nursery-quality plants, not big-box leftovers.

If you tell me a bit more about what you need, I can get very specific so you do not feel like you are taking a shot in the dark:

Are you looking for a rose, another perennial, or bulbs?
What is your USDA zone or your city and state?
What is the planting spot like (full sun or partial shade, in-ground or container, size of space)?
